Game Overview

At its heart, Transition is a hyper-casual game about guide a forlorn creature to discover his true colors by navigating vibrant platforms. Solve puzzles under the ticking clock, avoiding perilous black platforms. Immerse yourself in this emotionally resonant journey, embracing change and purpose through clever gameplay and a heartwarming narrative.
